title: Good but can improve
body:
I really like the colourful notes that I can take and the nice assortment. The app looks great. I have some suggestions for it to become better: 
1- please include the option to have small bullet points and list options, not only bulky tick-boxes. 
2- the colours in iPhone light mode are much nicer than dark mode colours. Please include the option to keep the colours as they are, even if the phone was entirely shifted to night mode. And its always nice to have more colour options. 
3- please include the option for different headers with different font sizes.
